svg.title: The Assignment Editor That Never Reschedules a Missed Day
svg.desc: A one-week schedule strip: five lit day-columns the run steps across, its path arcing over a crossed-out missed day, and a stub arrow below that day cut short — no makeup run reschedules it. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The Assignment Editor That Never Reschedules a Missed Day”. A isometric lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 2065161129.
